output_list.reason: The 'sellOffline' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows the owner to sell tokens in a restricted manner, where the amount of tokens to be sold is not validated, allowing an overflow of the 'remaining' variable, leading to a loss of funds.
The 'mintToken' function has a wrong logic where it allows the owner to mint tokens in an unrestricted manner, without any validation, causing a loss of funds.
The 'adm_trasfer' function has an access control vulnerability, allowing the owner to transfer tokens to any address, without any restrictions, causing a loss of funds.
